site.heroSubheadline: We provide world-class support to those who want to enter the most promising markets of Middle East & Africa, with the help of the most dynamic management team. We recognize that our team is what makes us who we are.
site.address: Office Number 2211, Al Rehan Block, Omniyat Building Mamzar, Dubai – UAE
site.aboutText: ZYVENTA was founded to serve as a link between international healthcare companies and the growing markets of Arabian Gulf and the Middle East. ZYVENTA bridges access gaps by partnering with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deploy and commercialize new pharmaceutical, biologics, and other healthcare solutions in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) Markets.
site.aboutSubtext: At ZYVENTA, we pride ourselves on our comprehensive approach to establishing and enhancing brand presence within the region's dynamic healthcare landscape. Our dedicated team oversees every phase and process necessary to cultivate a strong brand identity and market presence. With meticulous attention to detail, we integrate five essential divisions: Regulation, Marketing, Sales, Distribution, and Supply Chain Management.
site.mission: To bridge healthcare access gaps across the Middle East and Africa by delivering high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical and wellness solutions from global partners directly to regional markets.
site.vision: To become the leading and most trusted healthcare distribution and commercialization partner across the Arabian Gulf, Middle East, and Africa.
site.footerDescription: We serve as a link between international healthcare companies and GCC and the growing markets of the Middle East.

products.name: Zyvenkar
products.tagline: Controls BP and Future Complications Too
products.composition:
Amlodipine
A calcium channel blocker that helps relax and widen blood vessels, supporting improved blood flow and reduction of blood pressure.

Olmesartan
An angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that helps prevent the narrowing of blood vessels, thereby supporting effective blood-pressure control.
products.indication: Used for the management of hypertension (high blood pressure) in patients for whom combination therapy with Amlodipine and Olmesartan is considered appropriate.
products.description:
Zyvenkar combines Amlodipine and Olmesartan in a convenient, once-daily film-coated tablet designed for the management of hypertension for 24 hours.

The combination brings together two complementary antihypertensive agents that work through different mechanisms to help achieve effective blood-pressure control. By combining both active ingredients in a single tablet, Zyvenkar offers a convenient treatment option for patients who require combination therapy.
products.features:
1. Dual-action antihypertensive combination
2. Combines Amlodipine and Olmesartan in one tablet
3. Available in four strength combinations
4. Film-coated tablets
5. Convenient combination therapy for hypertension management
products.usage: Zyvenkar should be taken as directed by a healthcare professional. The appropriate strength and treatment regimen should be determined according to the individual patient's clinical requirements and blood-pressure response.
products.closingLine: Two complementary actions. One convenient tablet.

products.name: Desvenzyl
products.tagline: A modern SNRI for effective depression management
products.composition: Desvenlafaxine belongs to a class of medicines known as serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs). It works by helping increase the availability of serotonin and norepinephrine in the brain, neurotransmitters involved in mood regulation.
products.indication: Used for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD) in adults.
products.description:
Desvenzyl contains Desvenlafaxine, an extended-release antidepressant formulated to provide sustained delivery of the active ingredient over time.
It is designed for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD) in adults, helping to support the regulation of neurotransmitters involved in mood and emotional well-being.
The extended-release formulation allows for convenient once-daily administration, as prescribed by a healthcare professional.
products.features:
1. Desvenlafaxine extended-release formulation
2. Available in 50 mg and 100 mg strengths
3. Convenient once-daily dosing, as prescribed
4. Designed for sustained release of the active ingredient
products.usage:
Desvenzyl should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

Extended-release tablets should generally be swallowed whole and should not be crushed, chewed, or divided unless specifically advised by a healthcare professional.
products.closingLine: Reliable extended-release therapy for everyday treatment continuity.

products.name: Lacolep
products.composition: Lacosamide is an anticonvulsant medicine that helps reduce abnormal electrical activity in the brain associated with seizures.
products.indication:
Lacosamide is used for the treatment of partial-onset seizures and may be used either alone or in combination with other antiepileptic medicines, depending on the patient's treatment requirements.

It may also be used as adjunctive therapy for primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures in appropriate patients, according to approved prescribing information.
products.description:
Lacolep contains Lacosamide, an antiepileptic medicine used in the management of certain types of epileptic seizures.

Each film-coated tablet provides a precise dose of Lacosamide and is formulated to support effective seizure management as part of an individualized treatment plan prescribed by a healthcare professional.
products.features:
1. Lacosamide anticonvulsant therapy
2. Available in 50 mg and 100 mg strengths
3. Film-coated tablets
4. Precise and convenient oral dosing
5. Suitable for use as part of an individualized epilepsy-management regimen
products.usage: Lacolep should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional. The dosage and frequency of administration depend on factors such as the patient's age, clinical condition, response to treatment, and whether Lacosamide is being used alone or alongside other antiepileptic medicines.
products.closingLine: Precision dosing to support confident seizure management.

products.name: Febuvent
products.composition: Febuxostat belongs to a class of medicines known as xanthine oxidase inhibitors. It works by inhibiting the enzyme responsible for uric acid production, thereby helping reduce uric acid levels in the blood.
products.indication: Used for the chronic management of hyperuricemia in adult patients with gout, according to the approved prescribing information applicable in the relevant market.
products.description:
Febuvent contains Febuxostat, a medicine used for the long-term management of elevated uric acid levels in patients with gout.

Febuxostat helps lower serum uric acid by reducing its production in the body, supporting ongoing management of hyperuricemia associated with gout.
products.features:
1. prevent accumulation/recrytallization of uric acid in joints.
2.Xanthine oxidase inhibitor
3. Helps reduce elevated serum uric acid levels
4. Available in 40 mg and 80 mg strengths
5. Convenient oral tablet formulation
products.usage:
Febuvent should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

The appropriate dose should be determined based on the patient's clinical condition, serum uric acid levels, renal function, treatment response, and applicable prescribing guidance.
products.closingLine: Keep uric acid under control with dependable daily therapy.

products.name: Akthyod
products.composition: Carbimazole belongs to a group of medicines known as antithyroid agents. It reduces the formation of thyroid hormones in the thyroid gland.
products.indication:
Carbimazole may be used for: 
1. Treatment of hyperthyroidism
2. Preparation for thyroid surgery (thyroidectomy) in patients with hyperthyroidism
3. Treatment before and after radioiodine therapy, where clinically appropriate
products.description:
Akthyod contains Carbimazole, an antithyroid medicine used in the management of an overactive thyroid gland (hyperthyroidism).

Carbimazole works by reducing the production of thyroid hormones, helping restore thyroid hormone levels toward the normal range under appropriate medical supervision.

Akthyod is available in two strengths to support individualized treatment according to the patient's thyroid function and clinical requirements.
products.features:
1. Longer intrathyroidal levels
2. Carbimazole antithyroid therapy
3. Available in 5 mg and 20 mg strengths
4. Helps reduce excessive thyroid hormone production
5. Supports individualized treatment according to thyroid function
6. Convenient 100-tablet pack
products.usage:
Akthyod should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

The dose is individualized according to thyroid function tests and the patient's response to treatment. Regular monitoring of thyroid hormone levels is important during therapy.
products.closingLine: Flexible strengths for effective thyroid management.

products.name: Nourisil MD
products.tagline: The gold standard for scar management
products.composition:
Nourisil™ MD contains a combination of silicone-based ingredients and Vitamin E, including:

-Cyclopentasiloxane
-Caprylyl Methicone
-Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E)
-Dimethicone Crosspolymer
-PEG-12 Dimethicone/PPG-20 Crosspolymer
-Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate
-Dimethicone
products.indication:
Nourisil™ MD is designed for the prevention and management of new and old keloid and hypertrophic scars resulting from:

-Surgical procedures
-Wounds
-Trauma
-Burns
products.description:
Nourisil™ MD is an ultra-light, transparent and self-drying silicone scar gel designed for the prevention and management of new and old keloid and hypertrophic scars.

Its advanced formulation combines five silicones with Vitamin E to help maintain the skin’s moisture balance while improving the appearance and feel of scars.

When applied as directed, Nourisil™ MD dries to form a lightweight protective layer over the scar, helping to hydrate the area while supporting smoother, softer and flatter-looking scars.
products.availableStrengths:
Nourisil™ MD 10 g
Nourisil™ MD 30 g
products.features:
1. Helps flatten, soften and smooth scars
2. Helps reduce scar-associated redness
3. Helps relieve itching and discomfort associated with scars
4. Transparent and self-drying formulation
5. Lightweight, silky and non-greasy feel
6. Forms a protective, hydrating silicone layer
7. Suitable for application on areas including the face and joints
8. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin
9. Preservative-free and mineral-oil-free
products.usage:
Wash your hands and ensure the scar area is clean and dry.

Apply a small amount of Nourisil™ MD to the scar.

Gently massage the gel over the affected area.

Allow the gel to dry completely.

Once dry, sunscreen or cosmetics may be applied over the area.

Apply twice daily — once in the morning and once at night.
products.closingLine: Professional scar care designed for everyday confidence.

products.name: Nevral

5. Provides essential B vitamins involved in nervous-system function
6. Convenient once-daily tablet formulation
products.usage: 1 tablet daily, preferably during the main meal, or as directed by a healthcare professional.
products.closingLine: Everyday nutritional support for healthier nerve function.

products.features:

2. Helps soothe irritation and discomfort
3. Helps reduce swelling associated with haemorrhoids
4. Supports recovery of irritated skin and mucous membranes

products.name: Troxlmetacin Gel
products.tagline: Targeted relief that goes straight to the area of discomfort.
products.indication:

Joint pain
Muscle pain
Local inflammation
Swelling
Sprains and strains
Soft-tissue injuries
Tendon and periarticular discomfort
Other musculoskeletal conditions where topical anti-inflammatory treatment is appropriate
products.description:
Troximetacin Gel is a topical formulation designed to support the management of pain, inflammation and swelling associated with musculoskeletal conditions.

It combines Indomethacin, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), with Troxerutin, a flavonoid derivative commonly used to support microcirculation and reduce swelling.

The gel is intended for local application to affected areas, providing targeted treatment directly where discomfort occurs.

2. Helps relieve localized pain and inflammation
3. Helps reduce swelling
4. Designed for targeted topical application

products.usage:

products.closingLine: Targeted relief that goes straight to the area of discomfort.

Apply the adhesive side directly to the affected area.

products.name: Zynatis

products.features:

5. Direct application to the area of discomfort
6. Can be worn for up to 12 hours

products.name: Zybitel
products.composition:
Telmisartan
An angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that helps prevent angiotensin II from narrowing blood vessels, thereby supporting lower blood pressure.

Amlodipine
A calcium channel blocker that helps relax and widen blood vessels, supporting improved blood flow and blood-pressure reduction.
products.indication: Zybitel is used for the treatment of hypertension in adults, particularly where combination therapy with Telmisartan and Amlodipine is considered appropriate.
products.description:
Zybitel combines Telmisartan and Amlodipine in a single tablet for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension).

The formulation brings together two antihypertensive medicines with complementary mechanisms of action. Telmisartan helps block the effects of angiotensin II, while Amlodipine helps relax blood vessels by reducing calcium entry into vascular smooth muscle.

This dual-action approach provides an option for patients who require combination therapy to achieve appropriate blood-pressure control. Telmisartan/Amlodipine combinations are used in patients whose blood pressure is not adequately controlled with either component alone and may also be used as replacement therapy in patients already receiving both medicines separately.
products.availableStrengths:
Zybitel 80/5 mg – Telmisartan 80 mg + Amlodipine 5 mg

Zybitel 80/10 mg – Telmisartan 80 mg + Amlodipine 10 mg
products.features:
1. Fixed-dose combination of Telmisartan + Amlodipine
2. Dual-mechanism antihypertensive therapy
3. Available in 80/5 mg and 80/10 mg strengths
4. Metabolically neutral safe inn diabetes paitents
5. Convenient single-tablet combination
6. Suitable for individualized hypertension management
products.usage:
Zybitel should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

Telmisartan/Amlodipine combination tablets are generally administered once daily, with or without food. The dose should be individualized according to the patient's blood-pressure response, previous therapy and clinical condition.
products.closingLine: Dual-action cardiovascular support in one convenient dose.

products.name: Vildagard
products.composition:
Vildagliptin
A DPP-4 inhibitor that helps improve blood-glucose regulation by increasing the activity of incretin hormones, thereby supporting glucose-dependent insulin secretion.

Metformin Hydrochloride
A biguanide antidiabetic medicine that primarily helps reduce hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity.
products.indication: Vildagliptin/Metformin combinations are used as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycaemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, including patients inadequately controlled with Metformin alone or patients already receiving Vildagliptin and Metformin separately. They may also be used with other antidiabetic medicines, including insulin, when appropriate.
products.description:
Vildagard combines Vildagliptin and Metformin in a single film-coated tablet to support blood-glucose control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

The two active ingredients work through complementary mechanisms. Vildagliptin helps improve glucose-dependent insulin release and reduce inappropriate glucagon secretion, while Metformin helps reduce glucose production by the liver and improves the body's response to insulin.

The fixed-dose combination provides a convenient treatment option for appropriate patients who require both medicines as part of their diabetes-management regimen.
products.availableStrengths:
Vildagard 50/500 mg – Vildagliptin 50 mg + Metformin Hydrochloride 500 mg

Vildagard 50/850 mg – Vildagliptin 50 mg + Metformin Hydrochloride 850 mg

Vildagard 50/1000 mg – Vildagliptin 50 mg + Metformin Hydrochloride 1000 mg
products.features:
1. Enhances glycemic control with 1.1% HbA1c reduction
2. addresses key underlying defects of type 2 diabites
3. associated with low rissk of hypoglycemia and weight neutality
4. Fixed-dose combination of Vildagliptin + Metformin
5. Dual-mechanism approach to blood-glucose management
6.cAvailable in three strengths
7. Film-coated tablet formulation
8. Convenient combination therapy
9. 60-tablet pack
products.usage:
Vildagard should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

The dose should be individualized according to the patient's current treatment, blood-glucose control, kidney function and tolerability. Vildagliptin/Metformin combinations are commonly administered with food to help reduce gastrointestinal effects associated with Metformin. The recommended maximum daily dose of Vildagliptin is generally 100 mg.
products.closingLine: Two complementary mechanisms for confident glucose management.

products.name: Temlijub
products.tagline: Simple once-daily support for long-term blood-pressure control.
products.indication:
Telmisartan is used for:
- Treatment of essential hypertension in adults
- Cardiovascular risk reduction in selected high-risk adults, including certain patients with established atherothrombotic cardiovascular disease or type 2 diabetes with documented target-organ damage, where indicated by the approved prescribing information.
products.description:
Telmijub contains Telmisartan, an antihypertensive medicine used for the treatment of essential hypertension in adults.

Telmisartan belongs to the angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) class. By blocking the effects of angiotensin II, it helps blood vessels relax and widen, thereby lowering blood pressure and supporting cardiovascular health.

It has a smooth and sustained BP control over 24 hours
products.features:
1. Contains Telmisartan
2. Angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB)
3. Helps manage high blood pressure
4. Available in 40 mg and 80 mg strengths
5. Convenient oral tablet formulation
6. 30-tablet pack
products.usage:
Telmijub should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

For hypertension, the commonly effective Telmisartan dose is 40 mg once daily. In patients whose blood pressure is not adequately controlled, the dose may be increased to 80 mg once daily, depending on clinical response and medical advice.
products.closingLine: Simple once-daily support for long-term blood-pressure control.

faqs.question: What regions does Zyventa serve?
faqs.answer: ZYVENTA serves the Arabian Gulf (GCC) countries and the broader Middle East and Africa (MEA) markets, connecting international healthcare brands with regional distributors, pharmacies, and healthcare systems.

faqs.question: What services does Zyventa offer?
faqs.answer: Zyventa integrates five core divisions: Regulatory Affairs & Compliance, Strategic Marketing, Medical Sales Detailing, Seamless Wholesale & Retail Distribution, and Supply Chain Management / Cold Chain Logistics.

faqs.question: How does Zyventa ensure compliance with regulatory requirements?
faqs.answer: Our in-house regulatory team closely coordinates with regional health authorities including MOHAP (UAE) and other GCC bodies to manage product dossiers, fast-track registration, and maintain rigorous pharmacovigilance standards.

faqs.question: What sets Zyventa's marketing strategies apart?
faqs.answer: Our marketing team combines traditional on-site detailing and medical education with innovative digital marketing strategies, creating comprehensive demand generation from concept to customer.

faqs.question: How does Zyventa manage its distribution network?
faqs.answer: We maintain an integrated distribution network supplying hospitals, government bodies, retail pharmacy chains, and online channels with GDP-certified temperature-controlled storage and logistics.

blogs.excerpt: In today's ever-evolving healthcare landscape, the importance of effective medicine distribution and online selling cannot be overstated. content: In today's ever-evolving healthcare landscape, the importance of effective medicine distribution and online selling cannot be overstated. As a leading player in this field, Zyventa has positioned itself as a vital link between international healthcare companies and the burgeoning markets of the Arabian Gulf and the Middle East. With a firm commitment to bridging access gaps and promoting innovative healthcare solutions, Zyventa's role goes far beyond simply distributing medications. Therefore, it's about facilitating change and improving lives.

ZYVENTA was founded to serve as a link between international healthcare companies and the growing markets of Arabian Gulf and the Middle East. ZYVENTA bridges access gaps by partnering with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deploy and commercialize new pharmaceutical, biologics, and other healthcare solutions in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) Markets.
We recognize that our team is what makes us who we are. We pride ourselves on our professional, highly skilled and dedicated staff, each bringing their own unique skills to the business.
